description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and a ScrollView, used for displaying log data within an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays log messages using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, with automatic scrolling to the bottom when new log entries are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
